blocks.x: Who were some of the other members in the band?
Albert Nicholas. Red Allen, Ctis Johnson, (?) trumpets. (?)
How about, wasn't Wilbur DeParis in that band with you?
Not, that was Louis Armstrong's band.
Well, when this was recorded, this was with just one trombone?
That's interesting because I thought Wilbur DeParis was in that band along with you. I mean like when you recorded West End Blues and By and By.
When the Saints Come Marching In, that was just one trombone?
Oh, that was the big band?
Yeah. Maybe Wilbur was in it.
Yeah, I think so because I/some of those records ...
